key_insight: Self-building laboratories extend automation beyond running experiments to designing, configuring, and operating the laboratory setup itself.
engineering_relevance: Automating lab configuration could reduce manual integration work and make scientific automation more flexible across robots, workstations, and experimental goals.
method: Start from a high-level scientific goal and the available laboratory infrastructure.
Build missing capabilities, including lab layouts, digital twins, robot skills, and experimental workflows.
Coordinate experimental execution across single-workstation and multi-robot setups.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports demonstrations across different robots and setups, including multi-robot laboratories, and end-to-end validation through a real-world quantum-dot synthesis experiment.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify setup effort, reliability, or generalization to experiments beyond the demonstrated configurations.
